purpose: First post-pilot G1 historical qualification batch toward the 1,000 verified-entry Technical Alpha target.
authority_boundary: Selection and historical evidence do not constitute modern verification. No candidate in this batch is authoritative or production-visible until separately human reviewed, promoted, validated, and merged.

selection_policy.preference: concise or separable historical glosses suitable for controlled modern review

standard_cross_check.rule: Cross-checking is corroborative only and never automatically verifies spelling, meaning, POS, register, or current usage.

required_before_promotion: English equivalent or explicit omission rationale
stable sense/concept identity where multilingual release requires it
id_policy: New master IDs, if eventually promoted, begin at kha-000108 and are allocated only during a separate promotion step.
excluded_policy: OCR-contaminated, culturally sensitive, semantically overloaded, or unclear candidates are deferred rather than guessed.
